y_tail_q126.interpretation: 53H 0.4012 (single seed=42) is within the 5-seed range [0.3315, 0.5001] and very close to the across-seed mean 0.4179 (Δ -0.0167). However per-seed std=0.0787 exceeds STABLE threshold 0.02 by 4x and MODERATE threshold 0.05 by 1.57x. seed=42 happened to land near the bottom of a wide distribution → 53H is NOT lucky tail (would imply 53H significantly above mean), but it IS in a noisy regime. Headline 0.4012 understates the true model capacity (5-seed ensemble achieves 0.5617).
y_tail_q126.headline_lock_recommendation: REVISE — Headline should be reported as either (a) ensemble PR-AUC=0.5617 (5-seed mean prediction) OR (b) per-seed mean 0.4179 ± 0.0787 (95% CI ≈ [0.32, 0.52]) — NOT single-seed 0.4012. Existing 0.4012 'best ever' label is misleading both directions: single-seed claim hides high variance, but ensemble + diagnostic value is genuinely strong.
